 All the things worth checking out in one place.
 Photo: Courtesy of Coach and TWG Tea By  Nicole Ng  -  published 30 Oct 2026 
 Between our 9-to-5s and other obligations, it’s not easy to stay updated on the latest lifestyle news in Singapore, so consider this list below your cheat code to beating FOMO. From upcoming entertainment venues to anticipated local openings of popular international brands, here’s what’s worth checking out after work or on the weekend.
 Related article: Things To Do In Singapore This Weekend: 30 October To 1 November 
 The Coach Restaurant Celebrates Its’ First Anniversary
 Photo: Courtesy of Coach Inspired by its New York heritage, The Coach Restaurant Singapore is marking its first anniversary on our shores with a special one-weekend-only collaboration. Head Chef Kurt Sombero , formerly of Burnt Ends and Meatsmith Little India, is joined by Executive Chef Gabriel Jamias of The Coach Restaurant Jakarta for a four-hands menu of elevated Americana.
 Highlights include The Manhattan Double, which pairs a Corn Dog Deluxe with Caviar and Beef Tartare with a Jumbo Lump Crab Roll with Salmon Roe, and a Beefsteak with Burnt Onion Dip that riffs on the Philly cheesesteak. From the grill, tableside-carved sharing specials include a Slow Roast Linz Ribeye and a 1kg bone-in Aged NY Striploin, while dessert brings in a Banana Soft Serve Foster Split and Strawberry Shortcake. The Listening Table, the restaurant’s live music series of jazz standards and R&B, also returns across the three evenings.
 The anniversary specials are available for lunch and dinner from 30 October to 1 November 2026 at The Coach Restaurant, which is located at #01-207, Jewel Changi Airport, 78 Airport Boulevard. Reservations are recommended. For more information, visit The Coach Restaurant’s site . 
 Singapore Writers Festival Returns For Its 29th Edition
 Taking “Hidden in Plain Sight” as its theme, this year’s Singapore Writers Festival invites audiences to look closer at the stories we encounter and the assumptions we carry. It also marks Festival Director Yong Shu Hoong’s final edition at the helm. More than 300 writers, speakers and moderators will appear across over 200 programmes, including Amitav Ghosh , Tan Twan Eng , Silvia Moreno-Garcia and Jeremy Tiang . Look forward to sessions on literary translation, myths and legends, games and documentary filmmaking, as well as programming in English, Chinese, Malay and Tamil. There are also salon nights, mystery-themed experiences, family workshops and youth writing challenges.
 The Singapore Writers Festival runs from 13 to 22 November 2026. For more information, visit the Singapore Writers Festival’s site .
 TWG Tea Takes The Stage With Its Twelfth Night Advent Calendar
 Photo: Courtesy of TWG Tea TWG Tea is adding a touch of theatre to the countdown to Christmas with its limited-edition Twelfth Night Advent Calendar. Dressed in the brand’s signature canary yellow, it unfolds across 12 doors, each hiding a Mini Tea Tin of a beloved or exclusive blend, alongside a festive surprise. The doors are meant to be opened from Christmas Day into the New Year, in line with the traditional 12 days of Christmas.
 For more information, visit TWG Tea’s site .
 Schneider Electric And Apple Introduce A New Smart Thermostat And Power Mount
 Schneider Electric has unveiled two new products for the Apple Home ecosystem: a Smart Thermostat co-developed with Apple, and a Power Mount made exclusively for the newly announced Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted). The thermostat works through the Apple Home app, with Adaptive Temperature and hands-free Siri control, and it supports Matter and Thread so it stays connected even during an internet outage. Setup is just a tap of your iPhone. The Power Mount, meanwhile, holds the Apple HomeView against the wall with precision magnets, and comes in USB-C Wall Connector, AC Wired and Power over Ethernet (PoE) Wired versions.
 In Singapore, the USB-C Wall Connector and AC Wired Power Mounts can be ordered on Apple.com now, with availability in Apple retail stores from 13 November. For more information, visit Schneider Home’s site .
 Live Nation Announces Its Newest Project
 Photo: Courtesy of Live Nation Renowned concert organiser Live Nation is set to open Grange House , a sparkling new 3,000-seat live entertainment venue, right in the heart of Orchard Road. Designed to bridge the gap between intimate clubs and large-scale arenas: not too small, not too big, but just right for artists, promoters, and event organisers to cook up unforgettable nights. Beyond live shows, Grange House will feature indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, including a landscaped terrace and an all-day café and restaurant.
 Grange House is set to open by mid-2027. 
 Disney Adventure Reveals Its First Port of Call
 Calling all Disney fans! Disney Adventure cruise just got even more exciting with its first port of call in the picturesque island of Langkawi, Malaysia. Starting on 31 December 2026, the magical cruise journey will have an extra stop on select four-night voyages, where guests can marvel at the island best known for its lush rainforests and pristine coastlines.
 The port of call to Langkawi, Malaysia will start from 31 December 2026 on select voyages. For more information, visit the Disney Cruise Line website. 
 Ferrari Set to Open Its First Lifestyle Pop-up
 Courtesy of Marina Bay Sands Start your engines, Singapore: Marina Bay Sands is revving up for the 2026 Formula 1 night race season with a turbo-charged partnership with Scuderia Ferrari HP . From 25 September to 25 October, The Shoppes will host Ferrari’s first official luxury retail pit stop in Asia, featuring a curated selection of ready-to-wear, accessories, collectables, and design-led pieces under the creative direction of Rocco Iannone .
 The Ferrari Lifestyle boutique will be open from 25 September to 25 October at The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands. 
 Samsung Unveils Its New Line-up
 Photo: Courtesy of Samsung Samsung has unveiled a new line-up of devices to help us live smarter. Enter the Galaxy Z Series’ newest flip-phone instalments: the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and the Galaxy Z Flip8, the brand’s most intelligent and efficient mobile phones yet—with faster shortcuts, longer power and more.
 The new releases also include the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and Galaxy Watch9, which now come equipped with advancements that help the wearer gather complex biometric health data simply by wearing them.
 The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Flip8, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and Galaxy Watch9 are now available to shop. 
 Sushidan Is Now Offering Omakase Experiences
 The Negitoro Handroll with the Jiyu Omakase Set.
 Photo: Courtesy of Sushidan Sushidan is complementing its lineup of authentic yet wallet-friendly Edomae sushi with several omakase experiences. These sessions will take place in a hidden room behind the main dining area, at a six-seater chef’s counter. The 15-course omakase features appetisers, sashimi, sushi, a hot dish, grilled dish, handroll and dessert, though there are two other sets as well that will get you premium seasonal ingredients and a more elaborate experience.
 Sushidan’s omakase experiences are available strictly via reservations only, and reservations must be made at least three days in advance here . Sushidan is open from 11am to 10pm daily at #B1-44C, Raffles City Shopping Centre. For more information, visit Sushidan’s page. 
 Related article: The Buzziest New Restaurants, Cafes And Bars In Singapore 
 White Rabbit Launches Its First-Ever Pop-Up
 Photo: Courtesy of Hao Food SG Everyone’s favourite candy brand from their childhood now has a pop-up at Plaza Singapura. Look forward to a ton of themed merch, such as T-shirts , crossbody bags and caps that you can personalise at the Singapore-exclusive White Rabbit studio. There are also White Rabbit candy-scented pouch charms (featuring the adorable rabbit character) large enough to fit your AirPods and credit cards, as well as blind boxes containing plush keychains.
 Photo: Courtesy of Hao Food SG There’ll be mountains of the candy in mint, matcha, mango, coconut and other variations; halal-certified White Rabbit-flavoured ice cream in popsicle, cone and cup form; and exciting new additions such as the White Rabbit Toffee with Almonds Ice Cream Stick. There’s even a White Rabbit Dairy-Free Plum Popsicle to round the list off.
 The White Rabbit Pop-up runs from now to 24 November 2026 at level one of Plaza Singapura, from 10am to 10pm daily. For more information, visit White Rabbit Singapore’s page. 
 Related article: Your Guide To All The Fashion And Luxury Brand Cafés In Singapore 
 Yo-Chi Opens Its Second Location At Star Vista
 Photo: Courtesy of Yo-Chi Great news Westies, we’ve now got Yo-Chi swirling all the way to its second location at Star Vista. The Australian-based frozen yoghurt brand arrived in Singapore last August and has been making waves in town with long queues every hour of the day.
 Photo: Courtesy of Yo-Chi The soft serves are made using 100 percent fresh cow’s milk, which you can enjoy doused with toppings like fresh fruits, sauces, and, of course, its newest Dubai Chewy Cookie.
 Yo-Chi’s Star Vista branch is open daily from 10am to 10pm Monday to Wednesday, 10am to 11pm Thursday, 10am to 1am Friday to Saturday and 10am to 11.30pm Sunday, at #B1-12, Star Vista, 1 Vista Exchange Green. For more information, visit Yo-Chi’s site.
